name: redline
author: Vapen
description: Skip the gravity portals from 31% to 33% and fly over the cube portal. Go between the saw and invisible spikes at 34%. Stay at the floor from 37% to 82%. Hold the ceiling at 82% and then stop holding at 84.8% to land on the platform before the invisible saw. Navigate through the following section as the ship until 95%, where you can go between the saw and platform and then hold at the ceiling to the end.
